Reusable parameter annotations may vary as required by the checker. Valid dimensions are 0..32 inclusive; cells contains exactly width*height binary values in row-major order. The exterior is permanently dead, with no wrapping. Each synchronous step counts the eight OLD-board neighbors excluding the center: birth at three, survival at two or three, otherwise death. Return the complete ordered board, preserving binary range, exact shape and reusable input. evolve(0,w,h,c)=c; evolve performs exactly turns steps; evolving a then b agrees with a+b; empty boards remain empty. Finite behavioral gates exercise turns 0..8 but are not a universal proof. Invalid shapes, nonbinary inputs and dimensions outside the domain are unspecified. import Base

type Column is Data:
  Column{north: U32, life: U32, south: U32}

def Life.stencil(west: Column, center: Column, east: Column) -> U32:
  match west center east:
    case Column{nw, w, sw} Column{n, alive, s} Column{ne, e, se}:
      +neighbors = (nw + n + ne + w + e + sw + s + se : U32)
      Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
        U32.is_eq(neighbors, 3),
        Bool.and(U32.is_eq(alive, 1), U32.is_eq(neighbors, 2))))

def Halo.with(
  -R: Type,
  row: List<&2, U32>,
  next: U32 -> List<&2, U32> -> R
) -> R:
  match row:
    case Nil{}:
      next(0, Nil{})
    case head <> tail:
      next(head, tail)

def Life.line(
  cells: List<&2, U32>,
  above: List<&2, U32>,
  below: List<&2, U32>,
  west: Column,
  +center: Column
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Life.stencil(west, center, Column{0, 0, 0}) <> Nil{}
    case right <> rest:
      Halo.with(List<&2, U32>, above, right_up => above2 =>
        Halo.with(List<&2, U32>, below, right_down => below2 =>
          +east = Column{right_up, right, right_down}
          Life.stencil(west, center, east) <>
            Life.line(rest, above2, below2, center, east)))

def Life.row(
  above: List<&2, U32>,
  current: List<&2, U32>,
  below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match current:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case alive <> rest:
      Halo.with(List<&2, U32>, above, up => above2 =>
        Halo.with(List<&2, U32>, below, down => below2 =>
          Life.line(
            rest, above2, below2,
            Column{0, 0, 0}, Column{up, alive, down})))

def Rows.cut(
  height: Nat,
  +width: Nat,
  +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      List.take(&2, U32, cells, width) <>
        Rows.cut(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

def Life.rows(
  rest: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>,
  zero: List<&2, U32>,
  above: List<&2, U32>,
  +current: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rest:
    case Nil{}:
      Life.row(above, current, zero)
    case +below <> tail:
      List.append(&2, U32,
        Life.row(above, current, below),
        Life.rows(tail, zero, current, below))

def Life.enter(
  +zero: List<&2, U32>,
  rows: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case current <> rest:
      Life.rows(rest, zero, zero, current)

def step(
  width: U32,
  height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +w = U32.to_nat(width)
  Life.enter(
    List.replicate(U32, w, 0),
    Rows.cut(U32.to_nat(height), w, cells))

def evolve(
  turns: Nat,
  +width: U32,
  +height: U32,
  cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
